description.fun: Tepig blows fireballs from its nose, and when it catches a cold the fire turns to pitch-black smoke. It loves roasted berries but sometimes gets too excited and burns them to a crisp. It was the first Unova starter to be designed, and the fiery snout came from the way real pigs struggle to keep cool. Before its English name was out, fans called it 'Pignite', a name its evolution later got.
description.guide: Tepig is a Fire-type piglet and one of the three first partner Pokémon of Unova, and of Lumiose City in Pokémon Legends: Z-A. It blows fire from its snout and is quick on its feet. It evolves into Pignite and then Emboar.
description.tagline: A fire piglet that roasts its berries a little too well.

description.fun: Everything Pignite eats becomes fuel for the fire in its belly, so a full stomach makes it faster and stronger, and an empty one leaves it powerless. When it's angry or charging into battle, the flame flares until Pignite is wrapped in a scorching fireball. It'll stand up to any foe to defend a friend. Its line was designed in a Chinese style, perhaps nodding to the pig demon of Journey to the West.
description.guide: Pignite is the evolved form of Tepig and gains the Fighting type. Food fuels the fire in its stomach, which grows hotter when it is angry and makes it faster. It evolves into Emboar.
description.tagline: A fire pig that fights on a full stomach.

description.fun: Emboar wears a blazing beard of fire and sets its fists alight from its chin to throw fiery punches. The direr the situation, the more it seems to enjoy itself, yet it cares deeply for its friends. Ken Sugimori named its inspiration: Zhang Fei, the bearded warrior of Romance of the Three Kingdoms, which its Mega Evolution's serpent spear of fire makes plain.
description.guide: Emboar is the final form of Tepig, a Fire- and Fighting-type boar with a beard of flames. It sets its fists on fire to punch and grows more powerful as its flames intensify. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Emboar, introduced in Pokémon Legends: Z-A.
description.tagline: A fire-bearded wrestler boar modelled on a legendary general.

description.fun: Its fiery beard spreads into flame armour over its upper body, and it forges a serpentine spear of fire in its palms, like the serpent spear of Zhang Fei. Running high on emotion, it challenges anyone it meets, yet it will still risk its life for a friend in danger.
